concepts.title: غرفة الهروب
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-quality Arabic educational VIDEO GAME concept storyboard for Massar Academy, منصة مسار. This is a visual concept, not an implemented product. Brand colors from actual app: deep navy #0A1D3D, teal #0E8F8F, warm white #f4f1e7. Arabic RTL UI with legible short Arabic labels and a simple text wordmark "مسار" (do not invent a logo symbol). Audience Egyptian high-school students, sophisticated stylized 3D indie game art, tactile environments, atmospheric lighting, enjoyable real gameplay, not children clipart, not quiz form or dashboard. Create ONE large landscape image containing THREE clearly separated wide gameplay screenshots arranged as one large top shot and two equal bottom shots. Thin navy gutters, slim title strip, numbered shots. Each screenshot must show a different state of the same game, coherent assets and main character, tiny elegant HUD with pause, progress, hint icon. No laptop or phone frames, no marketing poster, no paragraphs. Use actual lesson themes: بناء الدولة المصرية; people vs residents; geographic space; legislative/executive/judicial powers; sovereignty. Minimal precise Arabic text; mostly communicate visually. Title "غرفة الهروب". An atmospheric Egyptian museum escape room in navy teal sandstone. Screenshot 1: playable third-person teenage explorer wearing teal jacket in a richly detailed museum chamber, three hotspots, locked monumental door with four empty sockets, inventory toolbar containing a map fragment and seal. Screenshot 2: close-up interactive mechanical puzzle table: three building-shaped compartments labeled "التشريعية" "التنفيذية" "القضائية"; player dragging a document marked "سن قانون" toward legislative slot, cyan target highlight, visible tactile movement and room background. Screenshot 3: solved chamber door opening with warm light into next room, one glowing foundation seal added to inventory, brief "تم فتح الباب" and small "المرحلة التالية" button. Feel like adventure escape game screenshots, exploratory camera and detailed clickable props.
